title: DeskShare — Requirements Gathering (source copy)
notes: Snapshot taken by /ba-sync (change-impact phase A, CHG-005). Confluence reports version 7 (fetch metadata.version); local baseline was v5 — v6 was never snapshotted (watch issue #1 reported v5 → v6), so this snapshot covers the cumulative change v5 → v7. This time getConfluencePage returned no version block (no createdAt, no message, no parentId) — version_created_at, version_message and parent_id are null, not empty; page lastModified was shown only as '19 min ago' at fetch time (2026-10-25). fetched_at: date of fetch, time not available. page.md = getConfluencePage markdown body; page.html = getConfluencePage html body (145 data-local-id elements, no trailing newline). Both differ from v5 in one place only: W1 Attendees — names 'Priya Nandakumar' and 'Sam Okafor' made bold.
